name: Code Review
description: Reviews the changes since a commit, branch or tag on two separate axes, the repo's documented coding standards and the originating spec, in parallel sub-agents reported side by side.
longDescription: Diffs `<fixed-point>...HEAD`, finds the spec (issue references in commit messages, a path you pass, or files under `docs/`, `specs/`, `.scratch/`) and the standards (`CODING_STANDARDS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`), then runs two parallel sub-agents. **Standards** applies a baseline of **12 Fowler code smells** (Mysterious Name, Feature Envy, Data Clumps, Shotgun Surgery and more), each a labelled judgement call that a documented repo standard overrides. **Spec** reports missing requirements, scope creep and wrong implementations, quoting the spec line. The two reports stay under separate headings, never merged or reranked. Issue fetching needs `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.
